rule: A shape outside the 13.3333 x 7.5 in stage fails the four-edge geometry gate unless an entry below matches its placeholder-ness, placeholder type, shape name and all four coordinates to 0.001 in, AND the edge it crosses is one the entry exempts. Naming a shape after an exempt one, or moving an exempt shape, matches nothing.

prior_mechanism.title_placeholder: ad hoc numeric threshold `y < -0.66` in the four-edge gate
prior_mechanism.production_panel: excluded by the reader's (x + w) <= 0 canvas/panel partition, which the four-edge gate never iterated past

exemptions.purpose: PowerPoint slide-title identity: outline pane, accessibility name, slide navigator and search. Off the top edge so it never paints on the learner canvas while remaining the slide's programmatic title.
exemptions.why_not_deleted: Deleting it would leave every slide untitled in the outline pane and in the accessibility tree. It is not proven unnecessary.

exemptions.purpose: Review-only production metadata panel. Deliberately parked left of the stage so a reviewer reads it in Normal view and a learner never sees it.
exemptions.why_not_deleted: It is the review surface this whole storyboard exists to carry.
